hints.title: Sum Definitions
hints.text: Element sum is the total of all numbers, while digit sum is the total of every individual digit.

hints.title: Digit Sum Invariant
hints.text: Since each number is greater than or equal to its digit sum, element sum is always at least digit sum.

hints.title: Difference Accumulation
hints.text: For each number x, subtract the sum of its base-10 digits from x and accumulate.

hints.title: Element and Digit Sum Difference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def differenceOfSum(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        elem_sum = sum(nums)
        digit_sum = sum(int(d) for x in nums for d in str(x))
        return elem_sum - digit_sum
```
